title: Air Fryer Chicken Souvlaki Wraps
description: Lemon, garlic and oregano chicken thigh with homemade tzatziki on warm flatbread. The tzatziki comes together while the chicken marinates.

steps.text: Combine the chicken ({{chicken}}) with the olive oil ({{oil}}), lemon juice ({{lemon}}), garlic ({{garlic}} cloves), oregano ({{oregano}}), salt ({{salt}}) and pepper ({{pepper}}). Toss well. Twenty minutes at room temperature is enough; a few hours in the fridge is better.

Coarsely grate the cucumber ({{cucumber}}), then squeeze it hard in the nut milk bag or a clean tea towel. Stir into the yoghurt ({{yoghurt}}) with the garlic ({{garlic-extra}} clove), lemon juice ({{lemon-extra}}), dill or mint ({{dill}}) and a good pinch of salt. Refrigerate until serving.
Slice the tomatoes ({{tomatoes}}) and red onion ({{onion}}), and shred the lettuce ({{lettuce}}). Soak the onion in cold water for 5 minutes if you want it milder, then drain.
Spread the chicken in a single layer in the basket, in two batches if needed. Air fry at 200°C for 12–14 minutes, shaking at the halfway point. You want charred edges, not just cooked through.
Warm the flatbreads ({{flatbreads}}) for 30–60 seconds in the air fryer at the end, or over a gas flame for a few seconds a side.
Spread tzatziki down each flatbread, add lettuce, tomato and onion, then the hot chicken. Roll tightly and wrap the base in foil or baking paper to hold it together.

notes.title: Confidence
notes.text: The marinade and tzatziki are standard Greek proportions. The air fryer timing is a starting point, so check the chicken at 12 minutes.

notes.title: Crowding
notes.text: A full basket steams the chicken instead of charring it. Two batches is worth the extra five minutes.

notes.title: Chicken breast
notes.text: Butterfly each fillet into two flat pieces rather than cubing. 190°C for 10–12 minutes, pulled at 75°C internal, then rest 5 minutes and slice. Cap the lemon marinade at one hour or the outside goes chalky.

notes.title: Yoghurt in the marinade
notes.text: Stir 2 tbsp of the Greek yoghurt into the marinade. It tenderises without the acid texture penalty and helps the char.

notes.title: One-basket dinner
notes.text: Halved chat potatoes in oil, salt and oregano at 200°C for 15 minutes. Push aside, add the marinated chicken with capsicum, red onion wedges and zucchini chunks, and cook a further 12–14 minutes at 200°C, shaking halfway. Rest 5 minutes and finish with lemon, feta and parsley.

notes.title: No air fryer
notes.text: Cast iron over high heat, 6–8 minutes turning once, in two batches.

notes.title: Storage
notes.text: Raw in the marinade 2 days in the fridge, or freeze it in the marinade. Cooked, 3 days; reheat in the air fryer at 160°C for 4 minutes.
